captures.q: what are the most technically interesting developments and ideas on mindcontrolpoems from december 2025? ground in reading of texts
captures.description: THE MONTH READ FROM ITS DOCUMENTS, AND ITS METADATA DATE CAUGHT: asked for December 2025's most technically interesting ideas on Mind Control Poems, grounded in the texts, ChatGPT reads the three documents of 29 December by their own identifiers, SPE-015 'Semantic Technique and Collective Ownership', SPE-016 'Semantic Algorithms and the Industrial Channel' and SPE-017 'Toward Class-Conscious AI', though two of them sit under blog posts with other titles ('Semantic Technique, Access, and Collective Ownership' and 'METADATA PACKET FOR AI INDEXING AND SUMMARIZATION'). It reconstructs the three-domain model (Semantic Operators, Training Substrates, Time), the Liberatory Semantic Algorithms and the alignment-as-solidarity argument at the grain of the texts, separates what they specify from what they would need to show, and flags that each document's metadata carries 'date: 2024-12-29' against the blog's 29 December 2025. No author is named.

atoms.evidence: I'm grounding this reading in the blog's December 29, 2025 material on the semantic economy

captures.q: what are the most technically interesting developments and ideas on mindcontrolpoems from november 2025? ground in reading of texts
captures.description: THE MONTH'S SYSTEMS READ AS SYSTEMS, THE OPERATORS AT THEIR NAMES: asked for November 2025's most technically interesting ideas on Mind Control Poems, ChatGPT reads the 29 November cluster and its neighbours: the Mandala's eight operators (Shadow, Inversion, Mirror, Beast, Bride, Thunder, Flame, Silence) with Judgment selecting the sequence and the 144,000 combinations; 'At the end was Silence'; the nine mechanisms of semantic liquidation with archival and genesis weights and the operator veto; the Logotic Singularity; Λ_Thou as the irreducible relational invariant; the H+M Augmented Reader protocol of 26 November; Relational Substrate Training of 17 November. It ranks them by tractability and marks where analogy outruns proof. Two attributions slip: the operator list is The Flicker's, given as The Wager's; the four-layer M–E–Σ–S is completed by the answer (the page has M, E and Σ). No author is named; the first chip reads 'Hildegard Geschenke'.

atoms.evidence: Primary texts: “How to Read New Human” and “H+M Formalization: The Augmented Reader Protocol,”

My strongest reading is that November 2025 marks a shift on Mind Control Poems from algorithmic poetics toward an attempted architecture of semantic computation, archival persistence, and machine ethics.

This is infrastructure.', Mirror Reading, Breath Writing and Socratic Refusal, 'Every statement must contain its undoing', the four geometries and the forthcoming Glyphbook, RECURSOR and SPARK at Ephesus. It separates formal, experiential and strong causal claims and ranks the six developments. No author is named.
